## About
Western Auto Crafters is a collision repair, auto body and paint shop on N Western Ave in Los Angeles. Marko, the owner, has dedicated his work life to auto collision repair.
Our goal is simple: understand what you need, fix your car right, and make the whole repair as easy as possible. We are a direct repair shop for a number of insurance companies, and customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 120 reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs for everything from small door dings to fender benders and major accidents.
- Auto body and paint: Body work and paint to bring damaged panels back to the way they should look.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We are a direct repair shop for a list of insurers, including USAA, Nationwide and Allied Insurance. Give us a call to check on yours.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car?
A: One customer said our front desk talked with Enterprise to have them picked up for a rental while we worked on their car. Ask us when you drop off.

Q: Will I know how my repair is going?
A: One customer said we sent them a link with frequent updates, so they could see the cost and progress as the work went along.
